title: lastrea villosa
intro: Lastrea villosa, commonly known as the hairy fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea villosa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Lastrea villosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
